Dashboard.Title: Runyth Tables of Sustenance
Dashboard.Intro: Browse 335 grounded foods, assemble meals, generate coherent menus, and manage packaged content.
Dashboard.BrowserHint: Search by region, venue, consumer, tier, legality, ingredients, and effects.
Dashboard.GeneratorHint: Build regionally coherent tavern, market, military, household, prison, ship, or ceremonial menus.
Dashboard.ComposerHint: Compose narrative meals while enforcing configured effect-stacking rules.
Dashboard.ManagerHint: Import and update stable, versioned world-compendium copies without overwriting protected edits.
Dashboard.TransferHint: Export a portable world configuration or safely import settings, image overrides, and module-managed content.
Dashboard.DiagnosticsHint: Inspect compatibility, packaged content, world compendia, image overrides, duplicate IDs, and complementary providers.
Dashboard.MechanicsUnavailable: Browsing and narrative tools remain available; inventory/effects are disabled.

Generator.Title: Shop and Menu Generator
Generator.IncludeLegendary: Include Tier S (separately warned setting required)
Generator.Empty: Choose a context and generate a menu.

Manager.Title: Content Management
Manager.LocalizedImport: Import names and descriptions in the active language
Manager.RemoveWarning: This removes selected module-managed entries from their world compendia. Packaged source data remains available.
Manager.ForceRestore: Force restoration from packaged sources and overwrite matching imported edits.
Manager.AdapterRequiredForFoods: Food Item import requires a compatible game-system adapter. Recipes and roll tables remain importable.

Composer.Title: Meal Composer
Composer.Intro: Choose up to six meal components. Side dishes are narrative by default unless the selected stacking rule permits another effect.
Composer.NoMechanicalEffects: This meal applies no mechanical food effect.

Consume.LegendaryWarning: This legendary food records a permanent actor benefit. It is intended as a rare narrative reward, not routine progression.
Consume.OverrideEnabled: GM override is enabled for this operation.

Chat.PermanentRecorded: A stable permanent legendary benefit was recorded on the actor.
Chat.RestHealingApplied: {actor} recovers {amount} additional Hit Point from legendary sustenance.

Errors.GMOnly: Only a Game Master can perform this operation.
Errors.NotFood: The selected document is not a Tables of Sustenance food item.
Errors.NoActorPermission: You do not control the target actor.
Errors.ServingOthersDisabled: Players are not permitted to serve actors they do not own.
Errors.CooldownActive: This actor is still within a Tier 4 cooldown.
Errors.DuplicateLegendary: This actor already has this permanent legendary benefit.
Errors.NoTargets: Select at least one token or assign a user character.
Errors.LegendaryGenerationDisabled: Legendary generation is disabled in world settings. Tier S food is never included by default.
Errors.InvalidRecipeImport: The recipe import file is invalid.
Errors.SocketTimeout: No active Game Master completed the serving request.
Errors.InvalidSocketUser: The requesting user is not active.
Errors.UnsupportedSystem: No compatible system adapter is active. Browsing and worldbuilding remain available; inventory materialization and mechanical effects require an adapter for the current game system.
Errors.SystemAdapterMissing: No system adapter is active for {system}. Food browsing, menus, recipes, lore, and narrative consumption remain available; inventory materialisation and mechanical food effects require a complementary system module.
Errors.SystemAdapterCapabilityMissing: The active adapter for {system} does not implement required capability: {capability}.
Errors.MechanicalConsumptionUnavailable: This food has a mechanical benefit that cannot be applied safely in the current system configuration, so no serving was consumed.
Errors.InventoryFoodRequired: Players can consume or serve only food Items held in an Actor inventory. The catalogue itself cannot create free servings.

mechanicsEnabled.Name: Mechanical food effects
mechanicsEnabled.Hint: Apply mechanics through the active game-system adapter and retain stable permanent-benefit records in the core.

StockFoundryLook.Name: Stock Foundry look
StockFoundryLook.Hint: Keep the stock Foundry UI design for the windows of Runyth Tables of Sustenance. By default they use the fleet-wide design language.

hungerThirstCompatibility.Name: Hunger and thirst compatibility
hungerThirstCompatibility.Hint: Expose nourishing and hydration flags for compatible modules.

tierSPermanentEffects.Name: Tier S permanent effects
tierSPermanentEffects.Hint: Permit legendary foods to record tiny permanent benefits.

playerSelfConsumption.Name: Player self-consumption
playerSelfConsumption.Hint: Allow players to consume food for actors they own.

playerServingOthers.Name: Players may serve others
playerServingOthers.Hint: Allow player requests to be routed to an active GM for actors they do not own.

legendaryConfirmation.Name: Legendary confirmation
legendaryConfirmation.Hint: Require a prominent confirmation before Tier S consumption.

automaticServingReduction.Name: Reduce servings automatically
automaticServingReduction.Hint: Decrease remaining servings after successful consumption.

deleteEmptyItems.Name: Delete empty disposable items
deleteEmptyItems.Hint: Delete actor food items after their final serving is consumed.

hideImperialClassifications.Name: Hide Imperial classifications
hideImperialClassifications.Hint: Hide regulated classifications from non-GM browser views.

legendaryGeneration.Name: Enable legendary menu generation
legendaryGeneration.Hint: Danger: allow Tier S foods to enter explicitly enabled generated menus.

recipesEnabled.Name: Recipe system
recipesEnabled.Hint: Enable recipe learning, checking, importing, and exporting.

spoilageEnabled.Name: Spoilage
spoilageEnabled.Hint: Enable spoilage metadata and compatibility hooks.

dietaryRestrictions.Name: Dietary restrictions
dietaryRestrictions.Hint: Warn when actor dietary flags conflict with food metadata.

preserveEditedImports.Name: Preserve edited imports
preserveEditedImports.Hint: Do not overwrite world-compendium entries changed after import.

priceScale.Name: World price scale
priceScale.Hint: Scale generated menu prices without changing packaged source data.

tier2Stacking.Name: Tier 2 stacking
tier2Stacking.Hint: Choose how multiple Tier 2 food effects interact.

tier3Stacking.Name: Tier 3 stacking
tier3Stacking.Hint: Choose how multiple Tier 3 food effects interact.

tier4CooldownRule.Name: Tier 4 cooldown rule
tier4CooldownRule.Hint: Choose whether all Tier 4 meals or only the same dish are blocked.

chatDetail.Name: Chat-message detail
chatDetail.Hint: Choose the amount of consumption information posted to chat.

weightUnits.Name: Weight display
weightUnits.Hint: Choose Imperial or metric display in module interfaces.

Cooldown.Strict: One Tier 4 per Long Rest plus dish cooldown

Dashboard.Name: Tables of Sustenance dashboard
Dashboard.Label: Open dashboard
Dashboard.Hint: Open the food browser, menu generator, meal composer, and content manager.

ContentManager.Name: Tables of Sustenance content
ContentManager.Label: Manage content
ContentManager.Hint: Preview, import, update, restore, and remove module content.

ImportExport.Name: Tables of Sustenance import / export
ImportExport.Label: Open import / export
ImportExport.Hint: Export or import world settings, image overrides, and exact module-managed content.

Diagnostics.Name: Tables of Sustenance diagnostics
Diagnostics.Label: Open diagnostics
Diagnostics.Hint: Inspect runtime compatibility, content integrity, imported data, image overrides, and complementary providers.

WindowGeometry.Name: Tables of Sustenance window geometry
WindowGeometry.Label: Reset window geometry
WindowGeometry.Hint: Reset client-specific saved sizes and positions for module windows.

Benefits.Title: Food Benefits and Cooldowns
Benefits.Intro: Review permanent legendary benefits and Tier 4 cooldowns. Contextual bonuses must be primed before the relevant roll; the module then adds the bonus and clears it after that roll.
Benefits.Primed: Primed for the next matching roll:
Benefits.None: No permanent legendary benefits are recorded.

Transfer.Title: Import / Export
Transfer.Intro: Move module configuration, image overrides, and exact module-managed content between worlds without treating unrelated Documents as module data.
Transfer.ExportHint: Create a portable JSON snapshot. Client-specific window geometry is intentionally excluded.
Transfer.ImportHint: Choose an export produced by this module. The preview is read-only until you explicitly apply it.
Transfer.ImportWarning: Import only writes this module’s settings, image overrides, and Documents carrying exact Tables of Sustenance provenance. Existing matching content is preserved unless overwrite is selected.
Transfer.InvalidFile: The selected file is not a valid Tables of Sustenance export.
Transfer.UnsupportedSchema: This export uses an unsupported schema version.

Diagnostics.Title: Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Intro: Validate the active runtime, content library, world compendia, image overrides, and registered complementary providers.
Diagnostics.NotRun: Diagnostics have not been run yet.
Diagnostics.FoundryVersion: Foundry {version} is outside the supported v13 line.
Diagnostics.SystemAdapter: No complementary system adapter is active for {system}; system-neutral core features are available, but Item materialisation and mechanics are unavailable.
Diagnostics.FoodCount: Only {count} foods are available; at least 335 packaged or registered foods were expected.
Diagnostics.LegendaryCount: Only {count} Tier S foods are available.
Diagnostics.ProviderMissing: Registered provider {provider} has no installed module {module}.
Diagnostics.ImageExtension: Image override {sourceId} uses a path whose extension is not a recognised web image type.
Diagnostics.FoodPackSystemMismatch: Imported food Items were materialised for {systems}, but the current world system is {system}. Re-import packaged foods through the active adapter.

WindowGeometry.Title: Window geometry
WindowGeometry.Intro: Reset saved client-specific window sizes or positions without changing world content or module settings.
WindowGeometry.Saved: Saved geometry exists for {count} module windows.
WindowGeometry.SizeReset: Saved module window sizes were reset.
WindowGeometry.PositionReset: Saved module window positions were reset.
WindowGeometry.AllReset: All saved module window geometry was reset.

Detail.Title: Food details
Detail.Missing: The requested food definition could not be found.
Detail.NoAdapter: No compatible system adapter is active. Lore and metadata are fully available; inventory and mechanical application require an adapter.
